elec.statusText: No live outage source available for Stellenbosch power
elec.note: OurPower.co.za's live outage tracker only covers Cape Town metro and doesn't cover Stellenbosch. esp.info (EskomSePush) does cover it but only shows a declarative status sentence intermittently — verified live it disappears whenever reports are ambiguous or absent, leaving only raw crowd-report counts, the same unreliable signal already ruled out for water. Left untracked rather than displaying an increasingly stale synthesized status as if current.

water.statusText: No live outage source available for Stellenbosch water
water.note: Neither OurPower.co.za nor esp.info has a reliable declarative water-outage status for Stellenbosch (a separate municipality from Cape Town) — esp.info only shows raw crowd-report counts with no synthesized status, which isn't reliable enough to classify automatically.
